HOW TO PLAY

🔫

3 Weapons

Pistol — Reliable single shots. Shotgun — Wide spread. Charger — Hold to charge, release a water beam.

🌊

Reload in Water

All weapons use ocean water as ammo. Walk into the sea to refill.

🌪️

Sand Burst (Right Click)

Unleash a powerful AoE shockwave that damages and knocks back all nearby enemies. Has a cooldown.

🦘

Jump (Space)

Hop over poison puddles or close gaps fast. Upgrade Spring Legs in the shop for higher, longer leaps.

W A S D Move    Shift Sprint    Space Jump

Left Click Shoot    Right Click Sand Burst

Mouse Look Around

🪙

Collect Coins

Enemies drop coins on death. Bosses and elites drop more. Lucky kills can rain a jackpot of shells.

💧

Health Drops

Some enemies drop water droplets — walk over them to recover HP between fights.

🛒

Upgrade Shop

Every 2 waves a shop opens. Upgrade weapons, health, ammo, Sand Burst, minions, and more.

🔄

Switch Weapons

Spend coins to switch between Pistol, Shotgun, and Charger. Each weapon levels independently — pick a track and invest.

📈

Wave Scaling

Costs and difficulty rise with every wave — bank coins early, spend smart later.

🏰

Your Home Base

The Burrow is your fortified base on the beach. Protect it — enemies will attack it!

💰

Passive Income

While the Burrow stands, it generates shells over time. Collect them nearby to fund your upgrades.

🦀

Minion Crabs

Hatch minion crabs at the Burrow that patrol the beach and fight enemies for you. Upgrade Minion Power for stronger allies.

🛡️

Repair the Burrow

Damaged Burrow? Deposit shells at it to rebuild — a destroyed Burrow goes offline and stops generating income until repaired.

⬆️

Burrow Upgrades

Use Fortified Burrow for extra HP and full heal, or Crab Army to raise the minion cap.

🐢

Turtles

Standard invaders. Some variants can dash at you — dodge their charge!

🐙

Octopus

Ranged enemies that hurl poison blobs from a distance. Their puddles tick damage if you stand in them — close the gap or jump over.

👑

Bosses & Elites

Massive bosses appear periodically. Elites glow gold with 2× health and damage. Watch for variants with unique abilities.

🌑

Cthulhu (Wave 7+)

The mega-boss. Rises from the abyss every 5 waves starting wave 7. Stays in the deep, but rains poison on your beach. The sky darkens, lightning strikes — survive him to clear the wave.

⚡

Storm Warning

When a moonlit storm rolls in with thunder, Cthulhu has woken. Trash mobs keep spawning until he falls.
